Name: Cooking with Gus
Author: cosplaywrite
Description:
Looking to expand your farmer's taste buds with some additional delights? Look no further with Cooking with Gus, an assortment of 10 recipes inspired by Reddit and one inspired by my own sweet tooth.

Learn how to cook:

Banana Bread
Cornbread
Crab Legs with Green Beans and a Biscuit
Lobster Tail with Salad and Garlic Mashed Potatoes
Paella
Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Cookies
Shrimp Scampi
Steamed Mussels
Strawberry Cake
Tomato Soup

Recipes are available at the Saloon and the Ginger Island resort bar.

Not compatible with Android or versions of SDV older than 1.5.
